ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added an Echo Show 5 and its stand, so another older smart display is not a priority.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Dot in Twilight Blue; the clock alone would not make me choose another now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Home monitoring interests me given my earlier door alarm purchase, and Alexa support fits my recent devices; I would check installation requirements.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already use a newer Dot and would get little benefit from adding this older model.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: An Alexa-compatible doorbell appeals to me, but I would explore the whole-home bundle this time rather than choose both.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Hard Drive, V-NAND Technology, Storage and Memory Expansion for Gaming, Graphics w/ Heat Control, Max Speed, MZ-V7S2T0B/AM; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought external storage, but I have no current internal-drive upgrade in mind or confirmed compatible M.2 slot.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV gaming bundle already included a Stick 4K Max, so this would duplicate its role.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases center on home electronics and computer accessories, and I am not currently looking for earbuds.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Extending Alexa to the car interests me, but I would check phone and car compatibility before choosing it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: USB Type C to 3.5mm Female Headphone Jack Adapter, JSAUX USB C to Aux Audio Dongle Cable Cord Compatible with Pixel 4 3 2 XL, Samsung Galaxy S22 S21 S20 Ultra S20+ Note 10 S10 S9 Plus, iPad Pro(Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy practical adapters when needed, but I have no current need to connect wired headphones to a USB-C device.
